title: Don't start a startup with the goal of getting acquired.
excerpt: If your goal is to cash out at $5 million as quickly and reliably as possible, becoming a founder is a very strange way to do it.
content_html:
July 27, 2026

Talking to a lot of early stage founders about working on different things, and this mindset is illogical and poisonous in its short term thinking.

Odds of getting into YC 1%. Getting acquired after that ~10%. Make this a very very simple estimate for your overall probability of being acquired as 0.1%.

If your plan was to take the first acqui-hire offer that you could get, let's say that's ~$5m for 2 founders. It's on a 4y vest.

Overall that's a 0.1% chance of getting $5m over 4y.

Why not just get a big tech job (>>0.1% chance), get promoted once, and then stay 10y? Even with high layoff rates at 2% per year, with a rest-and-vest strategy, you basically guaranteed make $5m, but just over a slightly longer time horizon.

Or, let's say you're currently in YC, why try to get acqui-hired for $5m (10%) vs just immediately going to big tech / finance / enterprise (you have YC on your resume, so you could probably get a 400k TC job at >50%). There's not really a point on the curve that values getting acquired early if you are trying to cash out at the first possible moment.

If your goal is to cash out and get to $5m, then you're probably many many times more likely to get to that number by just being a regular employee, albeit over a couple of more years.

Startups are go big or go home.

content_html_zh:
July 27, 2026

与许多早期创始人谈论从事不同的事情，这种心态在短期思维中是不合逻辑且有毒的。

进入 YC 的几率为 1%。 之后被收购~10%。 将此作为您被收购的总体概率的非常非常简单的估计为 0.1%。

如果您的计划是接受您可以获得的第一个收购聘用报价，那么假设这对于 2 位创始人来说约为 500 万美元。 它穿在 4 年背心上。

总体而言，在 4 年内获得 500 万美元的机会为 0.1%。

为什么不干脆找一份大型科技工作（>>0.1% 的机会），升职一次，然后呆 10 年呢？ 即使每年 2% 的高裁员率，采用休息和兑现策略，你基本上也能保证赚到 500 万美元，但时间跨度稍长一些。

或者，假设您目前在 YC，为什么要尝试以 500 万美元 (10%) 的价格获得收购，而不是立即去大型科技/金融/企业（您的简历上有 YC，所以您可能会以 >50% 的价格获得 400k TC 的工作）。 如果你想在第一个可能的时刻兑现，那么曲线上并没有真正值得尽早收购的点。

如果你的目标是兑现并达到 500 万美元，那么你通过成为一名正式员工达到这个数字的可能性可能要高出很多倍，尽管还要再花几年时间。

初创公司要么做大，要么回家。
